pages.caption: ПИРОТЕХНИКА / PIROTECHNIC — the locker for distress flares and rockets. "pirotechnic" is misspelled.
the pyrotechnics stencil, cut from a crew employment contract.
УКВ / VHF — the short-range radio, the one used to talk to other ships and ports.
the VHF stencil, cut from a radio directory of vietnam.
АИС / AIS — the system that broadcasts the ship's name and position to everyone nearby.
the AIS stencil, cut from a british admiralty form for reporting errors on charts.
an S, sprayed black.
an S, cut from the admiralty pilot guide for angra do heroísmo, the azores.
GP… — part of "GPS", sprayed.
the GP stencil, cut from the pilot guide for praia da vitória, the azores.
НАВТЕКС / NAVTEX — the receiver that prints out weather and danger warnings at sea.
the NAVTEX stencil, cut from a radio directory: vietnam, yemen, zimbabwe.
UBWE3 — the ship's radio call sign, its name over the air.
ИНМАРСАТ / INMARSAT — the satellite phone, for when land is too far for radio.
the INMARSAT stencil.
COMPASS, sprayed black.
the COMPASS stencil.
ГИРОКОМПАСНАЯ / GYRO ROOM — the room for the gyrocompass, which finds true north by spinning.
the gyro room stencil, cut from a crew list from taganrog, 2023.
ПВ/КВ / MF/HF — medium and high frequency: the long-range radio.
the MF/HF stencil.
MF/HF again, smaller.
АИС / AIS again, a second pair.
the second AIS stencil, cut from a radio directory of vietnam.
GPS, sprayed black.
the GPS stencil.
